observed: The canceled seed returned a PostgreSQL socket write i/o timeout; errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) was false.
expected: Cancellation is recognized, then the test verifies queued seed mail was suppressed.
scope: Discovered in existing API CI while a PR changed only the ATM runner pin. Two complete local ATM runs of the same application source passed.
hypothesis: Cancellation may surface through a driver transport error rather than wrapping context.Canceled. This is an inference, not a confirmed root cause.
impact: The failing invocation stopped before checking mail suppression. No conclusion about suppression correctness follows from this failure alone.
followUp: Reproduce repeated race-enabled seed cancellation against a disposable database.
Observe ctx.Err() alongside the returned driver error and verify cleanup invariants even if error identity differs.
Preserve unexpected real database errors while making cancellation assertions deterministic.
diagnosticRerun: The unchanged API job passed on attempt 2 (3m37s). The independent ATM GitHub run also passed its race-enabled API suite. The intermittent failure remains unresolved.
